# Postcommit error review

Source finding after the frozen error map: both current Analysis subscription receipt delivery and finite Instance execution could mask a Query error when Data had already committed a receipt.

No current native self-write check requires this fallback. Engine::check_read_scoped checks only current trace read authority. Output::complete invokes that guard after collection. Native stream check_store and Cursor::check_store check store/schema/recovery identity and reject only revision rollback, not a higher revision from the operation itself. Native count delivery and output accounting errors remain real errors.

The connected correction is Err-first: return the actual Query error and leave the original receipt in Data for an authorized retry or retained read. This is the existing lost-ack contract proved by instance::tests::denied_ack_keeps_receipt. It needs no pending-error field or extra owner. A benign typed authority notice reaches the host unchanged and can reopen from the saved native frontier. A real source denial reaches the host as denial and can suspend only the exact current lifecycle. The host owner is drafting this correction and its connected regression; no source or test pass is claimed here.

The exact error-leaf retirement gate therefore also includes qualification of the connected Err-first receipt path. The frozen REVIEW.md remains historical source evidence and is not rewritten.

No source, Cargo file, or Back file changed in this review. No build or test ran.
